source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year estimates, table B25034 (Year Structure Built)
scope: 3144 counties and county equivalents in the 50 states and DC (Puerto Rico excluded)

engine.note: nationally applicable rules only (no counties/states field)

changingRules.title: Confirm you received the federal lead-paint disclosure
changingRules.costToCheck: Free — required for most pre-1978 homes

changingRules.title: Identify the branch circuit wiring material
changingRules.costToCheck: Usually included in a general inspection — ask them to note the wiring material. Dedicated electrician evaluation $150 – $350.
changingRules.typicalRepairCost: Have a qualified electrician assess the wiring and recommend a permanent repair: copper rewiring, COPALUM or AlumiConn, depending on the installation. Typically $2,000 – $8,000+, depending on the number of connections and the scope of work.

changingRules.title: Check whether the supply lines are polybutylene
changingRules.costToCheck: Usually included in a general inspection — ask them to identify the material in writing

constantRules.title: Record the electrical panel brand
constantRules.costToCheck: Usually included in a general inspection — just ask them to record the brand

constantRules.title: Identify the foundation type and check for movement
constantRules.typicalRepairCost: Varies widely by cause and severity — from minor crack sealing to $30,000+ for major structural repair

constantRules.title: Test for asbestos only if you plan to renovate
constantRules.typicalRepairCost: Abatement varies widely by material and area

constantRules.title: Get the age and remaining life of the roof in writing
constantRules.costToCheck: Included in a general inspection — ask your inspector to estimate remaining roof life and note the material and condition

constantRules.title: Get the age of the HVAC system and water heater in writing
constantRules.costToCheck: Included in a general inspection — ask for the manufacture date on the furnace, condenser, and water heater data plates

constantRules.title: If the home has a fireplace or wood-burning stove, get a Level 2 chimney inspection
constantRules.costToCheck: $250 – $600 for a Level 2 inspection with a video flue scan
constantRules.typicalRepairCost: Flue liner replacement $1,500 – $5,000; partial rebuild $1,500 – $8,000; full rebuild $10,000 – $30,000+

constantRules.title: Consider a general pest and wood-destroying-insect inspection
constantRules.typicalRepairCost: Treatment $1,200 – $5,000 depending on method; structural repair if damage is present $1,000 – $9,000+
